name: Maher 2004
question: How do abdominal sacral colpopexy and vaginal sacrospinous colpopexy compare for vaginal vault prolapse?

design.population: Ninety-five women with symptomatic posthysterectomy vault prolapse reaching or passing the introitus were randomized; prior sacral colpopexy and markedly foreshortened vagina were excluded.
design.description: Prospective randomized surgical comparison; sample size assumed 58% versus 29% success, 80% power, and two-sided alpha 0.05
design.locator: Full text, Material and methods, p 21; Results, p 22

verdictNote: No equivalence margin was prespecified; success comparisons were nonsignificant, while anterior/vault recurrence differed.
takeaway: Among women with posthysterectomy vault prolapse, abdominal sacral colpopexy and vaginal sacrospinous colpopexy had nonsignificantly different subjective (43/46 vs 39/43) and objective (35/46 vs 29/42) success at mean 24 and 22 months; anterior/vault prolapse was less frequent after abdominal repair (6/46 vs 19/42).

reports.label: Primary report
reports.citation: Maher CF, Qatawneh AM, Dwyer PL, et al. "Abdominal sacral colpopexy or vaginal sacrospinous colpopexy for vaginal vault prolapse: a prospective randomized study." *Am J Obstet Gynecol.* 2004;190(1):20-26. doi:10.1016/j.ajog.2003.08.031

results.measure: No prolapse symptoms at postoperative assessment (46 abdominal and 43 vaginal women assessed)
results.note: Between-group difference did not meet the prespecified 5% significance threshold; no equivalence margin was specified. Six women (1 abdominal, 5 vaginal) lacked at least 6 months of follow-up; the printed 94% for 43/46 is an imprecise rounding of 93.5%.
results.locator: Full text, Material and methods, pp 21-22; Results, pp 22-23

results.measure: No prolapse of grade 2 or higher at any vaginal site on Valsalva (46 abdominal and 42 vaginal women assessed)
results.note: Results text gives P=.46; the article abstract gives P=.48. No equivalence margin was specified.
results.locator: Full text, Material and methods, pp 21-22; Results, p 23

results.measure: Patient-determined satisfaction at postoperative assessment, as reported
results.note: The text calls this mean patient satisfaction but reports counts and percentages; the VAS threshold for success is unspecified. No equivalence margin was specified.
results.locator: Full text, Abstract, p 20; Material and methods, p 21; Results, p 23

results.endpoint: Cumulative anterior wall and vault prolapse
results.measure: Postoperative anterior wall or vault prolapse among women with complete site-specific examination
results.note: Postoperative site-specific prolapse of grade 2 or higher; no between-group confidence interval reported.
Urinary distress and incontinence impact scores improved in both groups; adjusted between-group differences in SF-36 domains were nonsignificant.
results.locator: Full text, Table VII and Results, p 24

harms.label: De novo stress urinary incontinence and voiding dysfunction
harms.note: Between-group P=.09 for de novo SUI; no denominator stated for new voiding dysfunction.

harms.label: Complications and subsequent surgery

values.exp: 1 transfusion, 1 cystotomy, 1 mesh rejection, 1 infected-mesh removal, 1 wound infection, 2 incisional hernia repairs; 6 women had subsequent surgery (47 randomized)
values.ctl: 1 transfusion, 1 cystotomy, 1 rectovaginal hematoma, 1 vaginal pain; 7 women had subsequent surgery (48 randomized), including 2 Fenton repairs

harms.note: Subsequent procedures included continence and prolapse operations; Clavien-Dindo grades and mesh-exposure counts were not reported.

delivery.label: Operating time, return to daily activities, and cost

values.exp: Mean operating time 106 ± 37 min (n=47); return to daily activities 34.0 ± 12.1 days (n=46); mean cost A$6450
values.ctl: Mean operating time 76 ± 42 min (n=48); return to daily activities 25.7 ± 9.7 days (n=46); mean cost A$4575

delivery.note: P<.01 for operating time, return to daily activities, and cost; article table gives an internally inconsistent abdominal operating-time range, so only means are retained.
delivery.locator: Full text, Table VI, p 24; Results, p 25

delivery.label: Suspension technique and concomitant repairs

values.exp: Prolene mesh from vault to sacral promontory, extended to bladder trigone and 7-8 cm posteriorly; Burch colposuspension 14/47, paravaginal repair 19/47, posterior colporrhaphy 11/47, Moschcowitz 20/47
values.ctl: Unilateral sacrospinous colpopexy; Burch colposuspension 15/48, anterior colporrhaphy 21/48, posterior colporrhaphy 44/48, enterocele repair 28/48

delivery.note: All women received preoperative vaginal estrogen and perioperative antibiotic and antithrombotic therapy; procedures were supervised by consultant urogynecologists.
delivery.locator: Full text, Material and methods, p 21; Table IV, p 23
